#define OV_EVERSION   -134
extern "C" long __fastcall oggpack_read(oggpack_buffer* b, int bits);   // 0x00C915A0
extern "C" void __fastcall vorbis_info_clear(vorbis_info* vi);          // 0x00C8DFB0

extern "C" {
static __declspec(noinline) int _vorbis_unpack_info(vorbis_info* vi, oggpack_buffer* opb)
{
    codec_setup_info* ci = (codec_setup_info*)vi->codec_setup;
    if (!ci) return (-129);

    vi->version = oggpack_read(opb, 32);
    if (vi->version != 0) return (OV_EVERSION);

    vi->channels = oggpack_read(opb, 8);
    vi->rate = oggpack_read(opb, 32);

    vi->bitrate_upper = oggpack_read(opb, 32);
    vi->bitrate_nominal = oggpack_read(opb, 32);
    vi->bitrate_lower = oggpack_read(opb, 32);

    ci->blocksizes[0] = 1 << oggpack_read(opb, 4);
    ci->blocksizes[1] = 1 << oggpack_read(opb, 4);

    if (vi->rate < 1) goto err_out;
    if (vi->channels < 1) goto err_out;
    if (ci->blocksizes[0] < 8) goto err_out;
    if (ci->blocksizes[1] < ci->blocksizes[0]) goto err_out;

    if (oggpack_read(opb, 1) != 1) goto err_out; /* EOP check */

    return (0);
err_out:
    vorbis_info_clear(vi);
    return (OV_EBADHEADER);
}

// Same-TU caller (the _vorbis_unpack_info call of info.c vorbis_synthesis_headerin), present so the static gets retail's private
// convention. Not graded.
int __cdecl _vorbis_unpack_info_caller(vorbis_info* vi, oggpack_buffer* opb) { return _vorbis_unpack_info(vi, opb); }
